title: The proof tier after the proof-output module and the selected class binding, VF-018's three tests apart
description: Runs the proof tier's command (lib/tools/test_costs.py run --tier proof prints it) with cargo's --no-fail-fast and without the three heap tests VF-018 tracks (JBMC's timeouts, which no change here touches), as the jobs after examples 287 and 288 did. Two changes of the run of llm-dlc/loops/lib-architecture-fast-follow.md touch what every proof-tier test goes through. Commit 54011d1e moved what prove --json and equivalence --json print, and the process exit, into lib/src/proof_wire.rs, and made a regression check under --cache record what it did with each changed helper as data (equivalence::Outcome.helpers, stored by the proof cache) with the notes rendered from it. Commit bccff265 put every reading of a class's bytes in the checker behind one selection (ClassPath::bind and read_class in lib/src/classpath.rs: provider, JAR entry, bound release, a JVM's observation when one is given). The default tier (unit and tool) passed at both commits; this is the proof tier, which neither ran.
expected: exits 0: every proof-tier test but VF-018's three passes

resources.notes: the same job after example 288 took 35m47s at 3.4 GiB peak, and after example 287 1h07m at 3.3 GiB

steps.name: proof tier, no fail fast, VF-018's three skipped
steps.run: JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 JVMCONTRACT_HEAP_TIME_LIMIT=1800 JVMCONTRACT_TEST_TIER=proof TEST_COST=proof cargo test --manifest-path lib/Cargo.toml --release --no-fail-fast -- --ignored --test-threads 4 --skip the_output_relations_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_other_object_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm --skip the_parameter_reads_have_the_same_verdicts_under_jbmc_and_auto_confirm
